about: Decent Sync's plugin serving the first Machine at its Location (scripts/fake-decaid-recorder/decent-sync.mjs): the state the fake plugin starts from (fake-decaid/decent-sync.js). DYE2's keys as its Library's sync left them, the tablet's Shots pulled at the Location after the sample data's, and the server's Recipes, Profiles and Shots of the second Machine.

plugin.name: Decent Sync
plugin.author: Logan Fuller
plugin.description: Sends everything this machine records to a Decent Sync server: shots, steam records, workflow changes, machine state, the library, settings and paired devices. Shares the library's beans, bean batches, grinders and profiles with the other machines at its location. Requires Decaid v0.9.2 or newer.

ServerUrl.label: Server URL
ServerUrl.description: The Decent Sync server's address, shown with the token when the machine entry was created, such as https://sync.example.com or http://192.168.1.20:3000.

Token.label: Token
Token.description: This machine's token, shown once when its machine entry was created on the server.

PollSeconds.label: Poll interval (seconds)
PollSeconds.description: How often to check the library, app settings, paired devices, scale, sensors and Steam Records for changes. The machine's own settings are read every 60 s, or this often if longer, and whenever a Workflow change writes them. At least 5.

profileSnapshot.title: Adaptive v3
profileSnapshot.notes: This profile aims to unite the best practices in espresso extraction that we have learned so far with the Decent. It unites Brakel's Londonium, Rao's Blooming and Gagné's Adaptive profiles. The flow rate during extraction will automatically adjust itself from the flow rate actually happening during the Pressurize step and then gently increase it from there.  A 15g dose is typical.  Aim for a flow rate around 1.5 ml/s at the Pressurize step. 15g in, 33g out, in 32 seconds is a typical recipe for a medium roast.  Grind fine enough to keep dripping during preinfusion to around 4g. If you have a bluetooth scale, you can keep track of how much dripping into the cup there is before the ramp stage.  4 grams of total dripping, within 1 gram, seems to give the best tasting results. Try adusting your grind and dose to get that amount of dripping, and see if you like how it tastes.
